description: Geoscape National Buildings is a commercial national buildings layer for Australia from Geoscape Australia, maintained and updated from high-resolution satellite and aerial imagery across metropolitan, regional and remote areas. Buildings are linked to core location data including the G-NAF national address file, so that property-level datasets can be joined, and the product is described as quality-assured with trusted building characteristics. Users start from base buildings and can add insight packs such as roof, height, solar, swimming pools and first floor elevation, which gives the height of a building's habitable first floor above ground. Coverage: Australia. Access: licensed from Geoscape and partners; the page asks prospective users to get in touch. Licence: commercial; paid. Caveats: this is proprietary data, and the page read does not state update frequency or attribute accuracy. Simulation uses are building-level exposure for flood, bushfire and storm risk, where first floor elevation matters for flood damage, and roof and solar attributes for energy studies. Related records: the Microsoft and Google building footprint records, which also cover Australia at lower detail.
